correction: The native A/B artifact contract assumed the Forky systemd family stays at 261 and grepped the UKI initrd for a literal libsystemd-shared-261.so. Forky moved to systemd 262-1 on 2026-09-28, the initrd then carried libsystemd-shared-262.so, and the bare grep -q under set -e failed every native build with exit 1 and no message. The library name tracks the systemd major version, so it must be derived from the manifest's systemd version, not pinned.
evidence: main run 36479923827 (build-snow/build-floe installed 261.2-1 and passed; build-snowfield installed 262-1 and failed); PR #1016 run 36601917458 (all three native jobs on 262-1 failed at the same step); local fixture: origin/main script exits 1 silently on a 262 manifest+initrd
